# Load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(HDAnalyzeR)
library(patchwork)
library(ComplexUpset)
library(UpSetR)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(ggridges)
```

```{r}
ggplot2::update_geom_defaults(
  "point",
  list(size = 2, alpha = 0.6)
)
```

```{r}
source("../scripts/functions/functions_disease_analyses.R")
source("../scripts/functions/nice_plots.R")
source("../scripts/functions/run_de_analysis.R")
source("../scripts/functions/themes_palettes.R")
```

```{r}
hd_plot_volcano_custom <- HDAnalyzeR::hd_plot_volcano


```


## Load data

```{r}
metadata <- read_csv("../data/metadata.csv")
data_long <- read_csv("../data/data_long.csv")
data_wide <- read_csv("../data/data_wide.csv")
```

```{r}
data_wide |>
  filter(DAid %in% c("DA05925", "DA06048"))
```

# Differential protein analysis

## Grouped HIV-1 (baseline) vs. Healthy

```{r}
input_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(Timepoint != "Follow-up") |> 
  filter(Subcategory != "Elite Controller") |>
  mutate(Age = ifelse(is.na(Age), `Age (baseline)`, Age)) |>
  mutate(BMI = ifelse(is.na(BMI), `BMI (baseline)`, BMI))

input_data <- data_wide |>
  filter(DAid %in% input_metadata$DAid)
```

```{r}
hd_obj <- HDAnalyzeR::hd_initialize(dat = input_data, 
                        metadata = input_metadata, 
                        is_wide = TRUE, 
                        sample_id = "DAid",
                        var_name = "Feature",
                        value_name = "NPX")
```

```{r}
de_results <- hd_de_limma(hd_obj, 
                          variable = "Disease", 
                          case = "HIV", 
                          control = "Healthy", 
                          correct = c("Age", "Sex", "BMI")) |> 
  hd_plot_volcano(pval_lim = 0.05,
                  logfc_lim = 0.5,
                  top_up_prot = 10,
                  top_down_prot = 5,
                  title = FALSE,
                  report_nproteins = FALSE,
                  user_defined_proteins = NULL)

head(de_results$de_res)

de_res_hiv_baseline_healthy <- de_results$de_res
```

```{r}
p <- de_results$volcano_plot +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "significant down" = "#317EC2",
      "significant up"   = "#C03830",
      "not significant"  = "#C4C4C4"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "significant down" = "Significantly decreased",
      "significant up"   = "Significantly increased",
      "not significant"  = "Not significant"
    ),
    name = NULL   # removes legend title ("Significance")
  )

p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$size   <- 3
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$alpha  <- 0.7
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$stroke <- 0

p
ggsave(
  filename = "Volcano plot HIV vs healthy.pdf",
  path     = "../plots/pdf/volcano/",
  width    = 10,
  height   = 7)

ggsave(
  filename = "Volcano plot HIV vs healthy cut.png",
  path     = "../plots/png/volcano/",
  width    = 10,
  height   = 7)
```

## Grouped HIV-1 (follow-up) vs. Healthy

```{r}
input_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(Timepoint != "Baseline") |> 
  filter(Subcategory != "Elite Controller") |>
  mutate(Age = ifelse(is.na(Age), `Age (baseline)`, Age)) |>
  mutate(BMI = ifelse(is.na(BMI), `BMI (baseline)`, BMI))

input_data <- data_wide |>
  filter(DAid %in% input_metadata$DAid)
```

```{r}
hd_obj <- HDAnalyzeR::hd_initialize(dat = input_data, 
                        metadata = input_metadata, 
                        is_wide = TRUE, 
                        sample_id = "DAid",
                        var_name = "Feature",
                        value_name = "NPX")
```

```{r}
de_results <- hd_de_limma(hd_obj, 
                          variable = "Disease", 
                          case = "HIV", 
                          control = "Healthy", 
                          correct = c("Age", "Sex", "BMI")) |> 
  hd_plot_volcano(pval_lim = 0.05,
                  logfc_lim = 0.5,
                  top_up_prot = 10,
                  top_down_prot = 5,
                  title = FALSE,
                  report_nproteins = FALSE,
                  user_defined_proteins = NULL)

head(de_results$de_res)

de_res_hiv_baseline_healthy_fu <- de_results$de_res
```

```{r}
p <- de_results$volcano_plot +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "significant down" = "#317EC2",
      "significant up"   = "#C03830",
      "not significant"  = "#C4C4C4"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "significant down" = "Significantly decreased",
      "significant up"   = "Significantly increased",
      "not significant"  = "Not significant"
    ),
    name = NULL   # removes legend title ("Significance")
  )

p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$size   <- 3
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$alpha  <- 0.7
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$stroke <- 0

p

ggsave(
  filename = "Volcano grouped HIV vs healthy follow-up.pdf",
  path     = "../plots/pdf/volcano/",
  width    = 10,
  height   = 7)

ggsave(
  filename = "Volcano grouped HIV vs healthy follow-up.png",
  path     = "../plots/png/volcano/",
  width    = 10,
  height   = 7)
```

# Boxplots

```{r}
subcategory_colors <- c(
  "Primary HIV Infection"       = "#9FBFBA",  # teal / blue-green
  "Severely impaired immunity" = "#C97A73",  # mustard yellow
  "More preserved immunity"    = "#E3C35B",  # muted red
  "Elite Controller"           = "#6B6FA9",  # blue-purple
  "Healthy"                    = "#BDBDBD"   # neutral grey
)
```

```{r}
highlighted_proteins <- de_results$de_res |>
  filter(logFC > 0.5) |>
  arrange(adj.P.Val) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  bind_rows(
    de_results$de_res |>
      filter(logFC < -0.5) |>
      arrange(adj.P.Val) |>
      slice_head(n = 5)
  ) |>
  pull(Feature)

desired_order <- c(
  "Primary HIV Infection",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Severely impaired immunity",
  "Elite Controller",
  "Healthy"
)

p_up <- data_long %>%
  dplyr::select(DAid, Assay, NPX) %>%
  right_join(
    metadata %>% filter(Timepoint != "Follow-up"),
    by = "DAid"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Assay %in% highlighted_proteins,
    Subcategory %in% desired_order
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Assay       = factor(Assay, levels = highlighted_proteins),
    Subcategory = factor(Subcategory, levels = desired_order)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x     = Subcategory,
    y     = NPX,
    color = Subcategory,
    fill  = Subcategory
  )) +
    geom_quasirandom(
      alpha  = 0.7,
      stroke = 0,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      color = "black",
      outlier.shape = NA,
      alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ Assay, ncol = 5, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = subcategory_colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = subcategory_colors) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Expression of Selected Proteins by Cohort",
      x     = "Cohort",
      y     = "NPX"
    ) +
  theme_hiv() +
  # tilt the x-axis text 45 degrees
  theme(
    axis.text.x    = element_text(angle = 65, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  # remove x-axis text
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )

print(p_up)

ggsave(
  filename = "boxplot_top_differential_proteins_HIV_vs_healthy.pdf",
  plot     = p_up,
  path     = "../plots/pdf/boxplot/",
  width    = 12,
  height   = 8
)

ggsave(
  filename = "boxplot_top_differential_proteins_HIV_vs_healthy.png",
  plot     = p_up,
  path     = "../plots/png/boxplot/",
  width    = 12,
  height   = 8
)
```

```{r}
highlighted_proteins <- c("CD4", "CD8A", "CXCL13", "LTA4H", "NOS3")

p_up <- data_long %>%
  dplyr::select(DAid, Assay, NPX) %>%
  right_join(metadata, by = "DAid") %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Assay %in% highlighted_proteins,
    Subcategory %in% desired_order
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Assay = factor(Assay, levels = highlighted_proteins),
    Subcategory = factor(Subcategory, levels = desired_order),

    # 🔑 NEW: split baseline/follow-up except Healthy
    Subcategory_time = dplyr::case_when(
      Subcategory == "Healthy" ~ "Healthy",
      TRUE ~ paste(Subcategory, Timepoint, sep = " – ")
    )
  )

x_order <- c(
  "Primary HIV Infection – Baseline",
  "Primary HIV Infection – Follow-up",
  "More preserved immunity – Baseline",
  "More preserved immunity – Follow-up",
  "Severely impaired immunity – Baseline",
  "Severely impaired immunity – Follow-up",
  "Elite Controller – Baseline",
  "Elite Controller – Follow-up",
  "Healthy"
)

p_up$Subcategory_time <- factor(p_up$Subcategory_time, levels = x_order)

p_up_plot <- ggplot(
  p_up,
  aes(
    x     = Subcategory_time,
    y     = NPX,
    color = Subcategory,
    fill  = Subcategory
  )
) +
  geom_quasirandom(
    alpha  = 0.7,
    stroke = 0,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    color = "black",
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Assay, ncol = 5, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = subcategory_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = subcategory_colors) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 75, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Expression of Selected Proteins by Cohort and Timepoint",
    x     = "Cohort / Timepoint",
    y     = "NPX"
  )

print(p_up_plot)

ggsave(
  filename = "boxplot_selected_proteins_HIV_vs_healthy_baseline_followup.pdf",
  plot     = p_up_plot,
  path     = "../plots/pdf/boxplot/",
  width    = 14,
  height   = 8
)

ggsave(
  filename = "boxplot_selected_proteins_HIV_vs_healthy_baseline_followup.png",
  plot     = p_up_plot,
  path     = "../plots/png/boxplot/",
  width    = 14,
  height   = 8
)

```

## Subgroups (Baseline)

### Severely impaired immunity vs. healthy

```{r}
input_metadata <- metadata |>
  filter(Timepoint != "Follow-up") |> 
  filter(Subcategory %in% c("Severely impaired immunity", "Healthy")) |>
  mutate(Age = ifelse(is.na(Age), `Age (baseline)`, Age)) |>
  mutate(BMI = ifelse(is.na(BMI), `BMI (baseline)`, BMI))

input_data <- data_wide |>
  filter(DAid %in% input_metadata$DAid)
```

```{r}
hd_obj <- HDAnalyzeR::hd_initialize(dat = input_data, 
                        metadata = input_metadata, 
                        is_wide = TRUE, 
                        sample_id = "DAid",
                        var_name = "Feature",
                        value_name = "NPX")
```

```{r}
de_results <- hd_de_limma(hd_obj, 
                          variable = "Disease", 
                          case = "HIV", 
                          control = "Healthy", 
                          correct = c("Age", "Sex", "BMI")) |> 
  hd_plot_volcano(pval_lim = 0.05,
                  logfc_lim = 0.5,
                  top_up_prot = 10,
                  top_down_prot = 5,
                  title = FALSE,
                  report_nproteins = FALSE,
                  user_defined_proteins = NULL)

head(de_results$de_res)
```

```{r}
p <- de_results$volcano_plot +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "significant down" = "#317EC2",
      "significant up"   = "#C03830",
      "not significant"  = "#C4C4C4"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "significant down" = "Significantly decreased",
      "significant up"   = "Significantly increased",
      "not significant"  = "Not significant"
    ),
    name = NULL   # removes legend title ("Significance")
  )

p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$size   <- 3
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$alpha  <- 0.7
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$stroke <- 0

p

p_volcano_severely_healthy <- p

ggsave(
  filename = "Volcano plot severely impaired vs healthy.pdf",
  path     = "../plots/pdf/volcano/",
  width    = 7,
  height   = 10)

ggsave(
  filename = "Volcano plot severely impaired vs healthy.png",
  path     = "../plots/png/volcano/",
  width    = 7,
  height   = 10)
```

## Combine volcano plots

```{r}
sii_healthy_volcano <- p_volcano_severely_healthy
mpi_healthy_volcano <- p_volcano_preserved_healthy
phi_healthy_volcano <- p_volcano_early_healthy
ec_healthy_volcano  <- p_volcano_elite_healthy
```

# Follow-up vs. Baseline

## Updating limma function

```{r}
hd_de_limma_paired <- function(dat,
                               metadata = NULL,
                               variable = "Disease",
                               case,
                               control = NULL,
                               correct = NULL,
                               log_transform = FALSE,
                               paired = FALSE,
                               id_column = "ID") {

  Variable <- rlang::sym(variable)

  # ----------------------------
  # Input handling
  # ----------------------------
  if (inherits(dat, "HDAnalyzeR")) {
    wide_data <- dat$data
    metadata  <- dat$metadata
    sample_id <- dat$sample_id
  } else {
    wide_data <- dat
    sample_id <- colnames(dat)[1]
  }

  if (is.null(metadata)) stop("Metadata must be provided.")
  if (!variable %in% colnames(metadata)) stop("Variable not found in metadata.")
  if (paired && !id_column %in% colnames(metadata))
    stop("id_column must exist in metadata when paired = TRUE.")

  if (log_transform) {
    wide_data <- hd_log_transform(wide_data)
  }

  if (is.null(control)) {
    control <- setdiff(unique(metadata[[variable]]), case)
  }

  variable_type <- hd_detect_vartype(metadata[[variable]], unique_threshold = 2)

  # ----------------------------
  # Join data
  # ----------------------------
  meta_cols <- c(sample_id, variable, correct)
  if (paired) meta_cols <- c(meta_cols, id_column)

  join_data <- wide_data |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      metadata |> dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(meta_cols)),
      by = sample_id
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!!Variable %in% c(case, control)) |>
    dplyr::filter(!dplyr::if_any(dplyr::all_of(c(variable, correct)), is.na))

  # Force factor with correct levels
  if (variable_type == "categorical") {
    join_data[[variable]] <- factor(
      join_data[[variable]],
      levels = c(control, case)
    )
  }

  # ----------------------------
  # Build design
  # ----------------------------
  formula <- paste0("~0 + ", variable)

  if (!is.null(correct)) {
    var_types <- sapply(metadata[correct], hd_detect_vartype)
    for (v in correct) {
      term <- if (var_types[v] == "categorical") {
        paste0("as.factor(", v, ")")
      } else {
        v
      }
      formula <- paste(formula, "+", term)
    }
  }

  design <- model.matrix(as.formula(formula), data = join_data)
  colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))

  # ----------------------------
  # Expression matrix
  # ----------------------------
  data_fit <- join_data |>
    dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c(variable, correct, id_column))) |>
    tibble::column_to_rownames(sample_id) |>
    t()

  # ----------------------------
  # Fit model
  # ----------------------------
  if (paired) {

    block <- join_data[[id_column]]

    dupcor <- limma::duplicateCorrelation(
      data_fit,
      design,
      block = block
    )

    fit <- limma::lmFit(
      data_fit,
      design,
      block = block,
      correlation = dupcor$consensus.correlation
      # ⚠️ robust disabled by design
    )

  } else {

    fit <- limma::lmFit(
      data_fit,
      design,
      method = "robust",
      maxit = 10000
    )
  }

  # ----------------------------
  # Contrasts (categorical only)
  # ----------------------------
  if (variable_type == "categorical") {

    case_col    <- make.names(paste0(variable, case))
    control_col <- make.names(paste0(variable, control))

    if (!all(c(case_col, control_col) %in% colnames(design))) {
      stop(
        "Case/control columns not found in design matrix.\n",
        "Expected: ", case_col, ", ", control_col, "\n",
        "Found: ", paste(colnames(design), collapse = ", ")
      )
    }

    contrast <- limma::makeContrasts(
      contrasts = paste0(case_col, " - ", control_col),
      levels = design
    )

    fit <- limma::contrasts.fit(fit, contrast)
  }

  # ----------------------------
  # Empirical Bayes
  # ----------------------------
  fit <- limma::eBayes(fit)

  # ----------------------------
  # Output
  # ----------------------------
  de_res <- limma::topTable(
    fit,
    n = Inf,
    adjust.method = "fdr",
    confint = TRUE
  ) |>
    tibble::as_tibble(rownames = "Feature") |>
    dplyr::arrange(adj.P.Val)

  out <- list(de_res = de_res)
  class(out) <- "hd_de"

  return(out)
}
```

```{r}
  SII_up   = sii_healthy_sig_up$Feature,

  MPI_down = mpi_healthy_sig_down$Feature,
  PHI_up   = phi_healthy_sig_up$Feature,
  PHI_down = phi_healthy_sig_down$Feature,
  EC_up    = ec_healthy_sig_up$Feature,
  EC_down  = ec_healthy_sig_down$Feature
)

df_sets <- fromList(sets_list)

p <- ComplexUpset::upset(
  df_sets,
  intersect            = names(sets_list),
  width_ratio          = 0.1,

  sort_intersections_by= "cardinality",    # replaces order_intersections_by
  )

p

)
```

# Biological pathways

## Upregulated

```{r}
# 1) pull out each “significant up” vector
sii_up <- sii_healthy_de_res %>%
  filter(logFC   >  0,
         adj.P.Val <  0.05) %>%
  pull(Feature)

mpi_up <- mpi_healthy_de_res %>%
  filter(logFC   >  0,
         adj.P.Val <  0.05) %>%
  pull(Feature)

phi_up <- phi_healthy_de_res %>%
  filter(logFC   >  0,
         adj.P.Val <  0.05) %>%
  pull(Feature)

ec_ns  <- ec_healthy_de_res %>%
  filter(adj.P.Val >  0.05) %>%
  pull(Feature)

# 2) intersect all four
proteins <- list(sii_up, mpi_up, phi_up, ec_ns) %>%
  reduce(intersect)

# proteins is now a character vector of Features upregulated & significant in ALL four comparisons
length(proteins)  # how many overlap?
proteins  
```

```{r}
enrichment <- hd_ora(proteins, database = "GO", ontology = "BP")
```

# Boxplot examples

```{r}
proteins
```

```{r}
desired_order <- c(
  "Primary HIV Infection",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Severely impaired immunity",
  "Elite Controller",
  "Healthy"
)
```


```{r}
# install.packages(c("ggbeeswarm","dplyr","ggplot2"))
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)

# your proteins vector
# proteins <- c("CXCL13", "ICAM3", "CD6", "NOS3", ...)

# layout params
plots_per_page <- 12
n_cols         <- 4
n_rows         <- 3
n_pages        <- ceiling(length(proteins) / plots_per_page)

# open PDF
pdf("results/figures/figure 2/boxplots_all_up_proteins.pdf",
    width = 7, height = 7)

for(page in seq_len(n_pages)) {
  
  # which proteins on this page?
  start_idx <- (page - 1) * plots_per_page + 1
  end_idx   <- min(page * plots_per_page, length(proteins))
  prot_page <- proteins[start_idx:end_idx]
  
  # fetch & filter your data
  df_page <- data_long %>%
  dplyr::select(DAid, Assay, NPX) %>%
  right_join(metadata %>% filter(Timepoint != "Follow-up"),
             by = "DAid") %>%
  filter(Assay   %in% prot_page,
         Subcategory %in% desired_order) %>%
  mutate(
    Assay       = factor(Assay, levels = prot_page),
    Subcategory = factor(Subcategory, levels = desired_order)
  )
  
  # if for some reason there's no data, skip
  if(nrow(df_page) == 0) next
  
  # build the plot for this slice
  p <- ggplot(df_page,
              aes(x = Subcategory,
                  y = NPX,
                  color = Subcategory,
                  fill = Subcategory)) +
    geom_quasirandom(alpha = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_boxplot(color = "black",
                 outlier.shape = NA,
                 alpha = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~ Assay,
               ncol   = n_cols,
               nrow   = n_rows,
               scales = "free_y") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x    = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = sprintf("Protein boxplots (page %d of %d)", page, n_pages),
      x     = "Cohort",
      y     = "NPX"
    )
  
  print(p)
}

dev.off()
```

## Upregulated examples

```{r}
# Boxplot example of "PDCD1", "VCAM1", "SH2D1A", "IL32"
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)  # for geom_quasirandom

# define the four proteins
highlighted_proteins <- c("PDCD1", "VCAM1", "SH2D1A", "IL32")

# define the desired cohort order
desired_order <- c(
  "Primary HIV Infection",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Severely impaired immunity",
  "Elite Controller",
  "Healthy"
)

# build & save the plot
p_up <- data_long %>%
  dplyr::select(DAid, Assay, NPX) %>%
  right_join(
    metadata %>% filter(Timepoint != "Follow-up"),
    by = "DAid"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Assay %in% highlighted_proteins,
         Subcategory %in% desired_order) %>%
  mutate(
    Assay       = factor(Assay, levels = highlighted_proteins),
    Subcategory = factor(Subcategory, levels = desired_order)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Subcategory, y = NPX, color = Subcategory, fill = Subcategory)) +
    geom_quasirandom(alpha = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_boxplot(color = "black", outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6) +
    facet_wrap(~ Assay, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x    = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Expression of Selected Proteins by Cohort",
      x     = "Cohort",
      y     = "NPX"
    )

# display in R
print(p_up)

# optionally save to PDF
ggsave(
  filename = "boxplot_PDCD1_VCAM1_SH2D1A_IL32.pdf",
  plot     = p,
  path     = "results/figures/figure 2/",
  width    = 8,
  height   = 6
)
```
